# Evaluation report (generated by `python -m src.evaluate`)

Held-out test seasons: 2324, 2425, 2526 (1140 matches). Primary model, chosen by tuning-season CV before scoring the test seasons: **blend_lr_dixon_coles**.

Tuned parameters (walk-forward CV on 1011..2223): Elo {'k_factor': 20, 'home_advantage': 180, 'carryover': 0.75}, logistic {'C': 0.001}, XGBoost {'max_depth': 1, 'learning_rate': 0.03, 'n_estimators': 300}, Dixon-Coles {'xi': 0.0015}, blend weight on LR 0.6.
